hints.tr: Önce `urlsplit(url).scheme not in ("http", "https")` ise yalnızca etiket.
hints.en: First, if `urlsplit(url).scheme not in ("http", "https")`, only the label.

hints.tr: Bağlantıda adres de etiket de kodlanır; adresteki `&` `&` olur.
hints.en: In the link both the address and the label are encoded; the `&` in the address becomes `&`.

hints.tr: Çözümün tamamı: ```python import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit def safe_link(url, label): if urlsplit(url).scheme not in ("http", "https"): return html.escape(label) return f'{html.escape(label)}' print(safe_link("https://a.example/", "docs")) print(safe_link("javascript:go()", "click")) print(safe_link("http://a.example/?p=1&q", "x")) ```
hints.en: The full solution: ```python import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit def safe_link(url, label): if urlsplit(url).scheme not in ("http", "https"): return html.escape(label) return f'{html.escape(label)}' print(safe_link("https://a.example/", "docs")) print(safe_link("javascript:go()", "click")) print(safe_link("http://a.example/?p=1&q", "x")) ```
